Every night, Yeo-Un takes the last train home—same route, same time, same routine. But one thing keeps catching his eye: a girl with a guitar and a presence that lingers in his mind. But Hae-In isn’t just another fan—she’s the voice behind the band, a secret she can’t afford to reveal. As music draws them closer, the truth may threaten to pull them apart. The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him–even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom’s father. But Mugeuk didn’t accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.

As he faces death, he learns that Duke Delphine, the man who caused the downfall of his family, didn't work alone. Suddenly waking up as his teenage self, Cecil must work to both overcome his poor reputation and build up his strength to save his family. He decides to take guitar lessons and joins a music academy. There, he meets Cha Yeoreum, a young and passionate guitar instructor. As their friendship grows, Hyeonseon begins to rediscover a sense of vitality and excitement in his life. But life is never without its surprises. When Yeoreum starts to reveal his tender affection for Hyeonseon, their relationship takes an unexpected turn, bringing new challenges and emotions to the surface.

But after a strange creature attacks him in the mountains, he finds himself recruited into the Special Civil Service for the Ministry of Environment. This secret organization is dedicated to fighting nachal, human-devouring demons who appear in clouds of yellow dust. As Ma-Ru struggles in his new job fighting nachal, he must find out why they're mysteriously drawn to him before the prophesied end of the world arrives.

For his final job, he comes face to face with Savage Fang, the ruthless Wolf Den enforcer Yun Chi-Young. Everything goes (nearly) according to plan, but on his way back he is attacked and forced to return to his fearsome(?) true form…a little white cottonball of a puppy! After Chi-young finds Hui-Seong struggling on the streets, he takes him in, believing him to be nothing more than a stray. Will Hui-Seong be able to escape the ruthless, terrifying outpour of love Chi-Young showers him with and escape his criminal past? Or will he be forever leashed to a life of kibble and kennels?

With the police skeptical and her sanity on the line, Noa must navigate a web of fear and suspicion, guided by a ghost, to catch a ruthless killer before she herself becomes the serial killer. Will Noa uncover the murderer, or will her own mind betray her?

There’s absolutely nothing special about him. So when a sudden monster outbreak occurs on his campus, he must fight back every instinct screaming at him to run away as he takes a page out of his dad’s book and rushes to save his classmate. The chances of making it alive are looking bleak, until—PING! \[Congratulations on becoming a Player.\]

On one of his odd jobs, he ascends the great mountain Geumryang, unknowingly the home of an eponymous serpentine spirit. When Tae-Sun encounters the divine being, he too is on the brink of death, desperate for water in his slithering form. Tae-Sun offers him a sip of water, and saves the sacred snake from certain death. Later that night, a cold-blooded body embraces Tae-Sun and offers him an exchange: bear the ancient being’s seed, and his grandfather will live. But is all really as it seems? After all, can one ever truly trust the forked tongue of a serpent…?

However, his reign ends when he's defeated by the brutally strong Tesron, the "King of Fists." But death isn’t the end, because Leppenhardt awakens in Tesron's young body! Now armed with incredible strength and a new identity, he sets off to free the non-human races again. Can the new King of Fists reshape the world for all, or will his second chance slip away?

But sometimes, Aerik catches a flash of shrewd understanding behind those vacant eyes. Is Miesa truly as mad as everyone thinks... or is she hiding something?

Theo Ragnar, the 31st son of the mighty Grand Duke of Ragnar, was born without the legendary Ragnar Gift—a fatal flaw in a family where might is right. Labeled the “Ragnar Defect,” he and his mother were betrayed, meeting a brutal end at the hands of those they trusted. But death was only the beginning. Reborn at 17, Theo awakens not only with the Ragnar Gift, but with powers far beyond imagination. Fueled by vengeance and a second chance, he sets out to claim the glory he was once denied.

(Source: Tapas)

For seven years, Seo Hyeon-Jin, a Korean literature major, has nursed a secret crush on his upperclassman Soon Jeong-Wook. Unfortunately, Jeong-Wook only sees him as a cherished junior, leaving Hyeon-Jin’s love life at a standstill. Everything changes when Heo Chan-Yeong, who perfectly matches Jeong-Wook’s type, transfers in. To make matters worse, Chan-Yeong boldly confesses his feelings for Jeong-Wook to Hyeon-Jin, explaining that he wants to sleep with him. As if that weren’t enough, Chan-Yeong even asks Hyeon-Jin to help him win Jeong-Wook’s heart. Determined to protect the man he loves, Hyeon-Jin finds himself caught in a battle of wits against Chan-Yeong, who only wants Jeong-Wook out of curiosity.

But when Hyeon-Jin realizes Chan-Yeong’s “interest” might not be so fixed after all, he starts to wonder…could the rival he’s trying to fend off become something else entirely?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

When the hand that used to so lovingly hold Annette Rozenberg ends up being the one that causes the downfall of her family, Annette demands that Heiner Waldemar give her a divorce. But Heiner refuses, stating that he must see her miserable by his side, no matter what. At odds, the two continue a precarious relationship, only to be met with wounds of the past that bring them tragically together. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

She just wants to start fresh so she can graduate in peace. She just wants to leave behind all the bad memories — her sleepwalking, the trauma from being bullied at school — all of it. She did everything she could to keep to herself, but the class president, Hae-On, just won't leave her alone. One day, when Seul-Bi visits the local lake Hae-On recommended, she comes across something she never imagined seeing in her wildest dreams: a wild, dark mermaid. 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

*Note: Includes one extra.*

After humanity triumphs over the dangerous gates, a fragile peace is restored, yet the immense powers of espers become a dangerous double-edged sword. At the heart of this turmoil is Esper Zero, Michael, teetering on the edge of destruction. Enter Adam, a retired soldier haunted by the fractured bonds between espers and their guides. In a bold act of redemption, Adam offers Michael a second chance and a new identity: "Eve," symbolizing a fresh start and a spark of hope. But is peace truly possible for a person created for war…? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a life of hardship as an orphan, Ji-A Han finally achieves the dream of homeownership... only to have her moment of jubilation cruelly cut short. While indulging in her guilty pleasure--a riveting soap opera--she experiences a sudden, piercing chest pain and meets an untimely demise. But when she wakes up, she finds herself not in the afterlife, but within the very drama she was watching and as none other than its villainess! In a realm where a glance sparks a scandal and a step triggers a landmine of emotions, what fate lies ahead for Ji-A? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

On his first day at Nakseong High, Lee Jun enters more than a new environment. After a status window warns him of the school's horror stories, he is killed in a wave of gore and sent back to his first day. This time, Jun ignores the ominous window and tricks fate, only to be killed again three years later, forced to restart high school, and lead a brand-new horror story club. Pulled into this life-and-death game, can Jun rewrite the Nakseong urban legend once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

Woo-Yeon never liked Alphas, not before, and definitely not after he manifested as an Omega. The only person who ever made him feel seen was his tutor, Do-Hyun. Years later, Woo-Yeon follows him to university, hoping for a fresh start. But when they meet again, Do-Hyun doesn't recognize him. Woo-Yeon, however, never forgot—not his voice, his kindness, or the way Do-Hyun still makes his heart flutter. Then he learns the truth. Do-Hyun is an Alpha...

(Source: Tapas)

DJ, drop the beat! When 18-year-old K-pop stan Su-Hyeon gets his heart broken, he turns to his actual true love, girl group sensation MainTainA–especially his bias, the group’s main dancer, Hailey. Leaving his bittersweet first relationship behind to transfer to Seoul, Su-Hyeon finds not only a spitting image of his bias in the school dance club member Hye-Eun, who is supposedly Hailey’s younger sister, but also a new love in the most unexpected of places: the art of street dance! While helping Hye-Eun overcome her stage fright, Su-Hyeon finds there may be more to life than love!

After trouble child Kiana Ellie Freley leaves home to pursue her passion, she is satisfied living the academic life as a professor of magical engineering. In a last-ditch effort to reverse their fate, Kiana's cousin Melissa turns back time by one year, but only Kiana retains her memories. With just her summoned creature Chirpy by her side, can Kiana amend relations with her family and prevent their unjust end?

Josh, a brilliant lawyer and obsessive neat freak, is coping with a broken engagement. The only upside? His firm changed cleaning services. But when the new cleaner is Angel—his one-night stand from last night—chaos ensues. Is this love or just a messy disaster waiting to unfold?

Or, at least that’s the image of herself that Seojin has carefully crafted in order to indulge in her actual hobbies: reading hardcore smut! In reality, Seojin is just your average 'otaku,' fangirling and obsessing over steamy romance novels every night. Lately, her new obsession has been the one man in her life who remotely resembles a male lead in her romance novels - her boss, Yoon Taehyun! However, Seojin knows that her fantasies are destined to stay just that - fantasies. They're employee and boss, and nothing could change that. But when Yoon Taehyun discovers a crack in her perfectly curated persona, could their relationship potentially change into something else?

Spring, 1995. Messy-note business major and campus hottie Jinwoo needs someone to rewrite his essays so that they are at least somewhat legible. So when the two end up living under the same roof, it seems like the perfect opportunity to help each other out... but after a few fated run-ins, it might be more than just skills that they're swapping! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Baekya is childhood friends with Jichan, a well-known trash magnet. It has been and always will be Baekya's job to console Jichan after every one of his bad break-ups. One day, as Baekya was consoling Jichan yet again, the most popular boy in school, Lee Hyeon, appears in front of them. Knowing Hyeon's infamous streak of break-ups and bad boy stories, Baekya tries to stop Sichuan from falling for Hyeon when Jichan falls for him head over heels. Jichan even boldly asks Baekya to become friends with Hyeon just so he could set them up with each other. Baekya begrudgingly accepts and tries his best to become close to Hyeon, when one day Hyeon approaches him first and asks "Don't you think you're making it too obvious? I know you like me, but think you can stop it now?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

On the day of a group project presentation, college senior Lee Seung-Hyeon is falsely accused of sexual harassment on the subway, causing him to miss the presentation and fail the class. Desperate to salvage his GPA before graduation, he scrapes together enough money to enroll in summer classes, only to find himself stuck in another group project. To his horror, one of his groupmates, Seo Chae-Jun, turns out to be the very person who accused him of sexual harassment. Now, during what should have been a peaceful summer break, Seung-Hyeon is forced to confront his worst nightmare.

 *"What did I do that was so wrong to deserve spending this precious summer break of my senior year dealing with this lunatic?"*

All signs point to a clear lane for Leo to take home the championship for a second year in a row. But when J.J. suddenly breaks up with Leo, things start going south. With Leo’s fortuna (good luck charm) gone, his professional (and personal) life starts to suffer. How will he get rid of this monkey wrench in his plans and reclaim the driver’s high he once had…?

Realizing that Yohan might have crucial information about the case, Seonwu seeks his help. Yohan, attracted to Seonwu, agrees on the condition that they become friends with benefits. Their unconventional relationship deepens, but as the investigation nears its end, Yohan abruptly cuts ties with Seonwu and seemingly dies in a car accident, leaving Seonwu heartbroken. Three years later, Seonwu, now hardened by his past, spots Yohan in footage from a new NIS sting—alive and well, under the alias "Yohan Romanov," a notorious Russian mafia member. Hyde, a cold and love-averse individual, is tasked by the prince to go undercover as the tutor of Lily, the adopted daughter of Viscount Bardin, to uncover clues about illegal firearm trafficking.

*"And who will be the lucky gentleman to take your hand in marriage, my lady?"*

*"Lord Lucien Sornell, the first son of Count Sornell. Are you perhaps acquainted with him?"*

During his mission, Hyde discovers that his innocent and demure pupil, Lily, is engaged to Lucien, a notorious rake in high society. Ahh, yes. She's been adopted to be married off, so I guess now is when she comes in handy.

*"Mr. Hyde, what do you think the lord likes in a woman?"*

With her big, innocent eyes, Lily looks so pure, yet she has the delicate beauty of a painting. Her body is frail, yet she is well-developed in all the right places, and utterly adorable. For just one week, she vows to become the most beloved bride.

*"Mr. Hyde, if it’s not too much trouble, will you teach me how to do it?"*

*"Of course, Lady Lily. Teaching you is the greatest joy and pleasure I've known in life."*

Though Hyde despises getting his hands dirty and is in a constant rivalry with Lucien, he decides to masquerade as a genuine tutor, teaching Lily the refined ways of noble romance to give Lucien a taste of his own medicine. Will Hyde’s lessons turn Lily into the perfect bride, or will they uncover deeper, more dangerous secrets?

People call him a “half-baked” Esper, and the name has stuck ever since. After sustaining a serious injury, he has been reassigned to a desk job in the Guide Line Department, where he now trains rookie Guides. Life was relatively peaceful until one very specific problem arrived. Yeon Soo-Jung, a Guide Kyuhyuk once saved as a child and treats like family, has just come of age. And now, he wants to initiate a sex guiding session with Kyuhyuk. Worse still, Soojung makes his intent painfully clear:

 *“Just sleep with me once. Let me give you the sex guiding, please.”*

Sure, guiding is essential for Espers to stabilize their powers. But the idea of doing it with him sends Kyuhyuk into full panic mode. 

 *“Wait, Soo-Jung. I'm really not mentally prepared for this yet...”

Yoon pleads desperately for his life, but Tae-Shin responds with cold indifference—until he realizes that Yoon is the one person he once helped out of genuine compassion in a past encounter. Bound by that rare act of grace, Tae-Shin reluctantly postpones Yoon’s death. To justify this decision, Tae-Shin appoints Yoon as his temporary assistant. But the role comes with a heavy price: Yoon must regularly transfer yang energy to Tae-Shin through intimate physical contact. Though hesitant, Yoon agrees, knowing it's the only way to survive.

As the line between duty and desire blurs, both man and reaper are forced to confront their past, their bond, and the strange pull growing between them in the space between life and death.

Convinced his energy was stolen, Sun-Woo confronts him, and Seong-Han claims there is only one way to return it. Leon Winston, Captain of the Western Command's Domestic Intelligence Division in the Kingdom of Riphon, is both feared and revered. Known as the Vampire of Camden for his ruthless treatment of rebels, he strikes terror into both allies and enemies alike. But beneath his noble and elegant exterior lies a man consumed by a dark desire, one that burns as fiercely as his rage against the rebels. Sally Bristol, the unassuming maid in charge of the interrogation room, is the one who awakens this uncontrollable craving, fueled by the scent of her blood. And after a rebel spy mentions her name, Leon realizes he no longer has to suppress his violent desire for her. Will Sally be able to beg her way out of Leon's deathly grasp, or will she succumb to the bloodlust he can't resist?

Han Soo-Ah grew up with everything a girl could need. Or so she thought, until she realized she was no more than a tool at her father’s disposal. The best she could do for herself was live up to the expectations that sat heavy on her shoulders. She’s resigned herself to such a life, until a fateful encounter in a music store changes things forever. Will the man at the piano be able to restore what Soo-Ah doesn’t even know she has lost…?

Baek Dam treats contract worker Yeon-Il like a chew toy: dumping work on him, humiliating him, even exposing his alcohol-related trauma in a drunken slip. So when Dam wakes up bound in an unfamiliar place, a dog collar locked around his neck and a bowl of kibble shoved in front of him, he realizes the leash has changed hands. Cornered by a cold, unreadable Yeon-Il, Dam is forced into the role of “Yeon-Il’s dog.” As control tightens, desire and resentment twist together, and suddenly the rules of dominance and control are no longer so clear.

Soon, I transmigrated into the book as the villainess, Annette Ethelred. Annette is hated by everyone because she tried to kill Heine, but I'm not going down that route. I'm going to keep my head down, make money, and check out all the hot guys!

However, lacking experience, she fails to fully lift the curse leading to the stench vanishing for the emperor but only when Ersala is within his vicinity. Moreover, with Ersala being able to use magic only once a year, it seems she is tied to the emperor, almost quite literally, until she can attempt to lift the curse again.

Now trapped in the body of a lowly servant, Yoohui is forced to serve the infamous tyrant, but nothing is as it seems within the palace, with secrets, lies, and dangerous desires running rampant. Unfortunately, these two worlds clash when the new hire at work, Yi-Heon, finds out about Na-Hee's scandalous hobby. Claiming he can only get excited by looking at her naughty pics, he promises to keep her spicy secret if she continues posting them. From the outside, Taesung and Haeun look just like real siblings. They were certainly raised that way, living together in the same house since they were kids. But here’s the secret: they aren’t actually related. Haeun’s just been living with Taesung’s family since her parents went to live abroad, and that’s the way it’s been for the last 15 years. They’re basically real sister and brother at this point…until one day, Taesung comes to learn a prank from his friends. Grab a girl’s sides, and you can tell from her reaction what she really thinks of you. Taesung tries this out on Haeun that night, eager to see how she reacts…and accidentally ends up grabbing her boobs. Uh-oh. But just what is up with Haeun’s reaction? She’s blushing, squirming, not saying anything… Is this how you would normally act in front of your brother? And in those dreams, Revo always whispers the same chilling line, “Right here, this is where our baby will be born.”

The only way to send a spirit up to the afterlife is to satisfy its needs, and Do-Yoon is determined to suck the spirit right out of Yuan in more way than one…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hoseon has suffered from the war Jang started for far too long, and hope has grown scarce, but pharmacist Do-Ha Shin is determined to save as many lives as he can until the very end. Except, he wasn’t expecting to manifest as an omega at his age, and he wasn’t expecting to wake up surrounded by Hoseon’s army. He can’t remember the face of the alpha who found and brought him here, and he never got his name. Now, saving the lives of these soldiers could mean saving the life of his love.

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: ราชินีเหมันต์

description:
In a kingdom rotting from within, Rey, an Arcanist whose magic serves the city's power players, scrapes by in a dusty bookstore with one-night stands as his only relief. After one intense night with two men, one of them won’t leave. Behind his refined mask lies a decadent hunger — and Rey knows it's poison, but he can't stay away.

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: Got you！ Wonderland ～男だらけの極限ラブ～

description:
While on a school trip aboard a ship, Teacher Jihan has a strange dream about a goat man. He steps onto the deck to clear his head, only to be swept away by a huge wave. When he comes to, he finds himself on "Goats Island," where he meets Sea Bass and his friends—who all can’t remember a thing. As Jihan and Sea Bass fall head over hooves for each other, it becomes clear that their friends are “kidding” around with the truth, leaving Jihan to wonder what billy-big secrets they’re hiding.

(Source: Tapas)

Damian is a powerful duke with a demihuman condition that makes him averse to human scents. So when he sees Kanna—a girl sold into slavery by her own family—at an auction, he cannot resist buying her. Will this attraction grow into love, or remain a mere carnal instinct?

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: รังรัก รังแค้น

description:
Julia returns home after spending 12 years in a convent to find that Benjamin, the boy taken in by her father, has inherited her father’s earldom. She’s drawn to the kind and charming Benjamin, so when he asks to enter her room late one night, she finds herself unable to resist...

(Source: Manta)

He's the perfect man- except when it comes to a certain crucial aspect. One day, an unexpected significant enhancement changes everything.

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: แค้นรักอสรพิษ

description:
Mi-reu is an imugi who failed to ascend to heaven because she was betrayed by a human. After centuries of honing her sword of vengeance, she finally reincarnates and meets Keum Juyong, who carries the soul responsible for her demise. But for some reason, she keeps getting entangled in Juyong’s game instead! Will Mi-reu successfully get her sultry revenge?

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Part of RIDI's Yongyongjukgetji Danpyeonseon (용용죽겠지 단편선) Collection..*

Remember when high school drama felt way more serious than it really was? Well, in Taeyang City, there’s a little more on the line than gossip and hurt feelings. It’s more about loose teeth and broken jaws! With every high school in town ruled by a gang of hard-knock delinquents, the top dogs fight for dominance and the elusive title of “Myeongwang,” the greatest high school fighter of them all. At first, transfer student Ujae wants nothing to do with this, but he is soon dragged back into gang life to settle a score with the notorious Sunrise gang…

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: ヴァルプルギスの魔女医

description:
Upbeat witch doctor Kina Witchwood receives an ominous prophecy: she will face her execution in six months, but not before encountering three men--one she cannot refuse, one she cannot persuade, and one to whom she will vow her life. Though she tries to defy fate, she soon finds herself appointed as the emperor's personal physician and thrust into the heart of the imperial palace's trecherous political intrigues. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: ชำระแค้นรักแรก
いじめて抱きしめて初恋リベンジ

description:
At 28, Seo Yeon-Ho reunites with Ju Geon-U, his childhood first love, with only one thing on his mind: revenge. Determined to expose Geon-U's weaknesses, Yeon-Ho dives back into his life, only to find that his former crush has become a famous actor. But instead of gaining the upper hand, Yeon-Ho ends up being endlessly teased and outplayed by the very man he swore to take down…

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: スリージェントルマン

description:
Welcome to an LA Korean spa that accidentally turned into a holy ground for hot, chaotic gays! Enter Eden, a swoon-worthy CIA agent with the body of a Greek god, and Romeo, a mafia boss whose hands are as dangerous as they are... skilled. Both men lock eyes on one unsuspecting target: Su-Min, a sweet and slightly flustered Korean student working as a scrub master. Caught in a steamy love triangle full of slippery situations, shirtless standoffs, and suspiciously sensual scrubbing, Su-Min becomes the prize in a ridiculous showdown between brawn and finesse. Will Eden’s all-American muscles win him the boy? Or will Romeo’s sinful charm steal Su-Min’s heart (and maybe his towel)?

One spa. Two rivals. Three very questionable intentions. In the end... can’t they all just share the love?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Alpha Han Woo-Yeon's only goal is to find the love of his life, omega Ji Eon-Hyeong, marry him, and spend the rest of their days in blissful happiness. When they finally cross paths again, eight years later, it feels like fate since Eon-Hyeong has also been waiting for their reunion. But there’s one major problem... The delicate omega he remembers is gone, and in his place is a big, strong, strapping alpha who towers over Woo-Yeon. Can true love overcome such an unexpected twist of fate? Or is Woo-Yeon destined to lose his first love forever?

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: I Will Break off the Engagement With the Male Lead
男主と婚約破棄します

description:
After yet another rejected novel, a failing romance author finds herself mysteriously transmigrated into her own story! It would be one thing if she inhabited the body of her main character, but she instead finds herself in the shoes of the cruel villain of the story, Hawn-Hee Kang! Can this "relationship newbie" break up the engagement that'll lead to this villainess' untimely demise?

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: キャプテン・イブ -Captain Eve-

description:
After an attempt to steal a magical relic goes very wrong, Eve not only loses a friend but also her freedom. She is forced to summon a monster and enter a fighting arena with other imprisoned slaves. Years go by, and Eve has finally honed her skills and plans to exact her revenge on the man who captured her when a group of sky pirates looking for relics suddenly appears. In that moment, she makes the choice to escape with the pirates on their ship and sets off on a tumultuous journey to find her true path in life.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ju-Han is a devout deacon who regularly volunteers at an orphanage where Seong-Mi resides. Drawn by curiosity, Seong-Mi visits the church, only to stumble upon a shocking sight—Ju-Han, the very picture of restraint and virtue, consumed by his own forbidden desires, punishing himself in secret. A dangerous temptation begins to take root.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

titles.title: Touching Each Other Without a Gap
พันธะแห่งรัก

description:
Yeonu plans to end her secret affair with her boss, but an unexpected twist traps her in a bond she can't escape.

(Source: Toomics)

Award-winning cartoonist Keum Suk Gendry-Kim demystifies the inscrutable North Korean leader 

A woman falls over a thin black line, slicing her in two—half becoming North Korea, the other half becoming South. From the Island of Ganghwa, a seemingly idyllic rural paradise just an hour outside of Seoul, North Korea sits mere miles away, visible from cartoonist Keum Suk Gendry-Kim’s home and studio. It looms over her while she walks her dogs through the rice paddies. Artillery fire, helicopters, and sirens from a nearby military base paint her acoustic landscape. Gendry-Kim has written extensively about the pain and heartbreak experienced throughout Korea’s recent history in her award-winning books Grass and The Waiting. In My friend Kim Jong-Un, Gendry-Kim looks not to the past, but to the present—to the man currently responsible for upholding the national divide. 

Retracing his rise to power and uncovering his human side, Gendry-Kim explores the life of the supreme leader of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea: from his birth to his international education, his tastes and hobbies, and his relationships. Gendry-Kim weaves her personal accounts from this process throughout the book, in her signature approach to personal nonfiction by including interviews with former South Korean president Moon Jae-in, North Korean defectors, researchers, journalists, Kim’s former chef, and a friend from his boarding school days in Switzerland. 

My Friend Kim Jong-Un carries a message of peace and attempts to make sense of an awful chapter in Korean history. Translated by the award-winning Janet Hong, My Friend… is a cautionary tale and education on what makes a dictator, at a time when these lessons are more relevant in the West than ever. 

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

titles.title: Wonderland: Black Cage（ワンダーランド：ブラックケージ）
ワンダーランド：ブラックケージ
梦境：黑色牢笼 Wonderland：Black Cage

description:
Every single day, Chong-Suk is killed in whatever way his creator, Bae-Soo, pleases. How is it possible to die multiple deaths? Well, with the technology of Wonderland Black Cage, anyone can live out their wildest revenge fantasies! Humiliated by your crush? Let your fury fly free in the WBC app! But all good things come at a price. The more Bae-Soo plays, the more Chong-Suk adapts. And with the app’s AI secretly guiding Chong-Suk’s every move, who’s controlling who?

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: El lobo con piel de cordero
หมาป่าในคราบแกะ

description:
After a traumatic incident in high school left Se-Jin with emotional scars (and a three-year delay), all he wants now is to quietly graduate from Korea’s top university with decent grades. But what was supposed to be his easiest class turns into a paired project from hell, and who just so happens to be his teammate? The overly friendly, overly handsome Wu-Hyeon, of course! Not only is this guy clingy like lost puppy, but there’s something about him that puts Se-Jin on edge… Why does Wu-Hyeon seem so familiar, and how does he know so much about Se-Jin…? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

Abandoned by her ex-husband Douglas, Cassia rises to become a wealthy merchant. However, when a penniless Douglas returns begging for forgiveness, she gives him one last chance — only to fall into his trap and lose everything. But just when all seems lost, Cassia is granted a second chance to change her fate.

(Source: Manta)

For over half his life, Gye Neul has devoted himself to the Baekya crime syndicate, serving as the personal ashtray for Yong Inyeop, the boss's son. With a body marked by cigarette burns and a tongue stripped of taste, Neul has resigned himself to this cruel existence. His only solace is that Inyeop has never violated his body further. But one day, an order sends Neul on a business trip, forcing him to confront a bloody past.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Carefree chaebol Seo-Hee Lee agrees to marry her university acquaintance Seung-Hyun Chae in a strategic marriage—only to realize too late that his mother is the stuff of nightmares for a daughter-in-law. Can Seo-Hee survive her toughest challenge yet and perhaps even find true love?

(Source: Manta)

One day, Helse decides to offer herself as a hostage to the Kartago, known as the brawny descendants of wolves. There, she discovers that the wolves have strong desires and practice sharing unmarried women among their men! Between the wolf monarch and a virgin noblewoman unfolds a captivating romantic fantasy, where two individuals from contrasting cultures explore their connection through physical intimacy.

Step into a world where no fantasy is off limit, and no desire too delusional... Follow stories of guys getting exactly what they want, however they want it, whoever they want it with.

After being unadopted three times, Camellia is determined to stand on her own and applies for a position at the famous Bloomberry Tea Garden.

Though there are unsavory rumors surrounding the owner, Brandon Worthing, the people of his estate treat her surprisingly well, as if she's a noble lady instead of a mere employee.

But regardless of these puzzling circumstances, Camellia flourishes in her new role as a tea maker, moving people's hearts with her special blends. Little does she know that there's a reason why Brandon hired her, and that their history goes back much further than she thought...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Three different couples, three unique love stories—each beginning in their own unexpected way.

Song Kichan & An Hyejin
A battle of pride started by a petty argument. Wait… did they just accidentally start dating?! A classic friends-to-lovers romance.

Seo Kijun & Shin Ahyoung

Ha Taewook & Yang Hyein
An exciting first date! And what better to bring two young lovebirds closer together than a cafe pager? A heartwarming love story between a girl with an explosive libido and a pure-hearted boy.

คุณลูกค้าครับ ผมมีสินค้าลับๆ(?) มาขาย

Perpetually the lowest-ranked salesman, Giseok faces termination due to poor performance. His only way out? Becoming the top salesperson. Desperate, he turns to pillow deals, the ultimate sales taboo. Can he overcome temptation, jealousy, and office politics to rise to the top?

(Source: Lezhin US)

As secrets unfold and hidden motives come to light, Dojin must navigate a web of deception, art, and an unspoken connection that keeps pulling him back...

Raised by conservative educator parents, Ji-Soo could never dream of straying far from their high moral standards. However, there was that one time when she had a passionate one-night stand with a cute stranger she met while clubbing with her friends. To her great surprise, she runs into him five years later as her company's newly appointed CEO!

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: ฟิตเนสสะท้านรัก

Maeng Byeongtae has it all — a privileged background, a flawless physique, and more than enough where it counts. As a personal trainer, women were just passing distractions, good for relieving tension and nothing more. But everything changes when Seo Jihye walks into his gym. A new client. A married woman. The kind of trouble Byeongtae usually avoids without a second thought. And yet, something about Jihye — her quiet poise, the way loneliness clings to her — begins to shake his resolve.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After crashing her ex's wedding, high school teacher Si-Yeon drowns her heartbreak in a hotel bar, only to end up in a reckless one-night stand with a charming young man. Although she’s ready to forget the night ever happened, she's thrown into chaos when he appears at her school as her new coworker. As if that wasn't bad enough, he turns out to be Ha-Jun, a former student she taught years ago. While Si-Yeon struggles to keep her walls up, Ha-Jun boldly closes the distance, refusing to let their past—or their night together—stay buried.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ha-Min was the quiet, chubby kid with a hopeless crush on his friend’s older brother. Years later in college, he's slimmed down and unrecognizable. When Tae-Rim starts treating him with the same gentle warmth as before, Ha-Min finds his feelings rushing back.

(Source: Manta)

An unprecedented virus spreads across the world. After deserting the military upon learning the truth behind its human experiments, Tae-an is captured once again. When he wakes up, the first thing he sees is the gentle smile of the laboratory director watching him. Trapped inside an obsession he cannot understand, Tae-Han begins to slowly break.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After breaking her heart 10 years ago, Minjoo’s first love returns, wanting her to bear a child for him.

(Source: Lalatoon)

titles.title: 俺の幼馴染、恋愛の定義がだいぶ違う

description:
Hye-Sung just hasn’t been the same since the accident. For one, his best friend, No-Eul, can’t help but notice Hye-Sung's new tentacles, among other things. Actually, Hye-Sung seems like an entirely different person every other day...and this alternate personality is a lot more forward about his desires for No-Eul. No-Eul would do anything for his best friend, but does that include dating the alien inside him?!

(Source: Tapas)

There's no place like home...

Having grown up in a nursing home, Sheena wished for nothing more than to be reunited with her family. But when she finally returns home after 9 years, she finds herself feeling like a stranger in her own house as things take an eerie turn.

(Source: Manta)

Reincarnated as the heroine of a novel she once read, Veronica seeks revenge against her tyrannical father. Amidst a web of intrigue, she cautiously aligns herself with the enigmatic Prince Lowen and Duke Evan, who happen to be the murder suspects of her previous homicidal death. As Veronica carefully carry out her plan of revenge, she also finds herself drawn to Lowen and Evan, unraveling hidden truths of her past life.

description:
Baek Heon, the ruthless CEO of the criminal syndicate Yusu, finds himself under investigation by prosecutor Seol Ji-Hun for allegedly plotting to assassinate a congressman. Inside the interrogation room, Baek Heon becomes instantly captivated by Ji-Hun and makes a chilling decision. If he’s going to hell, he’s taking this good-looking prosecutor down with him. Ji-Hun’s life is soon upended. Framed for crimes he didn’t commit, he ends up behind bars, his once-promising future shattered. But Baek Heon isn’t done yet. For a man who confesses his deepest desire is to ruin a prosecutor, he’s more than ready to drag Ji-Hun into his world of obsession and poison—and Ji-Hun might just be daring enough to see how far he’ll fall.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: レベル１の最強ハンター

description:
Boss raids are an amazing opportunity for hunters. That’s why Gun-Woo Lee agreed right away when he was asked to join. An intense battle ensued, but Gun-Woo and his guild mates got the Boss’s health down to 30 percent. However, that triggered an effect, and now the Boss is about to explode in three minutes. Gun-Woo and his guild mates sense that they won’t be able to defeat the Boss in time, so they decide to escape. As they were about to get out, Gun-Woo was betrayed and trapped inside the dungeon…

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

description:
In his school days, Baek Kiho was an easy target, overweight, quiet, and even cursed with a name that classmates mocked as “Piggy Ho.” Years of relentless bullying drove him to drop out, leaving only scars and shame behind. But time changes everything. Kiho shed the weight, changed his name to Heeseong, and built a new life where no one could recognize the boy he once was. Then fate delivers an unexpected blow: his first love, Cheon Bokyeong, reappears. The very same Bokyeong who once despised him now approaches warmly, unable to connect Heeseong with the outcast she knew in the past. Torn between the longing he still feels and the terror of exposing his past, Heeseong hides the truth and lets their fragile relationship grow. But secrets have a way of surfacing and for Heeseong, the fear of losing both love and dignity weighs heavier than ever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: Between My Wife's Elder Sister and My Wife's Younger Sister

description:
When Noah, a struggling web novelist, finds himself in an unexpected marriage with Jane, one of three sisters who once tormented him, his life takes a chaotic turn. As Jane is sent overseas for work, her empty home becomes a playground for her two sisters— Lisa, a sultry divorcee, and Emily, a bold college student. The odd cohabitation stirs unexpected emotions as Noah is torn between Jane’s provocative allure and Emily’s carefree spirit. As old feelings resurface and new temptations arise, Noah is caught in a tangled web of desire, guilt, and forbidden attraction. Will he find clarity amidst the chaos, or will he be forever trapped between the two sisters?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Yoon-Su coaxes new kid Yi-Shin into joining him for Sports Day. Yi-Shin finds him annoying, but once he realizes he always has him on his mind, he decides to transfer back to Seoul. Yoon-Su, in tears, promises to visit, but 3 years pass since his last text. Yi-Shin, feeling used, decides to use him back.

(Source: Manta)

Se-Jin, a dedicated high school teacher, reunites with Ju-Hwan, the school’s temporary chairman—and her first love. After an unexpected night, she tries to leave it as a memory. But Ju-Hwan suggests a three-month “bedmate” relationship, and Se-Jin finds herself sinking deeper into feelings she meant to forget.

(Source: Manta)

In war-torn Alea, there is endless destruction over the search of “Shelkrino,” a dangerous ancient artifact. Thus, Durand’s father Tomas, a member of the Sky Congress, kept a piece of Shelkrino hidden in his body for years. Eventually, evil comes knocking at their door and Tomas has to sacrifice himself to save both the artifact and Durand. Enraged by the death of his father, Durand takes the risk of awakening his abilities as a summoner by using Shelkrino. With this newfound power and the help of his comrades, Durand sets off on a path to avenge his parents and put an end to the war once and for all.

(Source: Tappytoon)

titles.title: พันธนาการสองใจ

description:
Seong Serim grew into womanhood without having ever felt love from a man. No matter how she used her body or her words, it never seemed to be enough. So when she meets Cha Juhyeok, who cares for her despite his cold demeanor, she is instantly smitten. Fast forward years later, and she is the successful CEO of her own entertainment company. One of her actors, Ha Yeonwu, will do anything to please his boss…anything. With two men vying for her attention, their touches both intoxicating, how is Serim supposed to choose? Well, maybe she doesn’t have to… 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ichigar, the king, returns to the city without his Guardian. During an investigation following an assassination attempt, he notices Eli, a slave. Despite Eli’s protests, he orders him to be his personal Guardian. As Eli tries to find a way out of his duties, this only attracts the king’s attention.

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: If You Don't Fall In Love, You Die
If You Don’t Love, You Die

description:
Deoksun Kim, a 111-year-old mogul, built a thriving food empire, but her one regret was never experiencing true love. Miraculously reincarnated as 25-year-old Dohui, she sets out to fulfill her dying wish—only to be betrayed by her lover and lose everything. Fueled by vengeance, she soon faces an impossible ultimatum: fall in love within 111 days or suffer eternal torment in Hell. With time running out, will Deoksun seek revenge or take another chance at love?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

titles.title: 宇宙の果てまで Would You Love Me？

description:
High schooler Gyu-Bin Ji, a psychic who can read minds, meets Byeol Yu, a mysterious new classmate. The twist? Byeol is actually a human-hating alien in disguise, sent to decide humanity’s fate! As unexpected sparks fly between them, Gyu-Bin must win Byeol's heart—and save Earth! Will he make it?

(Source: Manta)

While working undercover at Heaven's Harvest Sect, a cult devoted to a so-called god of abundance, journalist Jang Gi-Jun expects the usual lies and fanaticism. Instead, he finds Hui-Sae, a young and eerily serene cult leader forced to "share blessings" through his own body, offering himself to frenzied followers in rituals disguised as salvation. Convinced he's on to a bigger scoop that expected, Gi-Jun watches the lines blur between devotion and exploitation, quickly realizing that the cult’s darkest secrets may lie not in its doctrine, but in what it demands of the one they claim is divine.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: 릴리 오브 더 밸리 (LILY OF THE VALLEY)

He followed him everywhere, chased off anyone who tried to get close to him, regardless of whether they were male or female, and declared him his future husband to anyone who would listen. To Yi-Chan, he was just a clingy little brother figure, unbearably persistent and impossible to shake off. So the moment he entered university, he disappeared from Eu-Na's life entirely, convinced he had finally escaped. Three years pass, and Yi-Chan returns from military service relieved that the nightmare is over. Until the first day of class. The two seem to share nothing in common—until a film project brings them together. Enoch is cast as the lead in a movie based on Nan-Woo’s life and insists on shadowing him to prepare for the role, ignoring Nan-Woo’s initial discomfort. As Enoch stays by his side—warm, passionate, and unexpectedly gentle—Nan-Woo’s walls slowly begin to crack. description:
I transmigrated into a fantasy novel where the male protagonist, in his attempt to save the world, loses his comrades one by one, leading to eventual destruction. My role is a villainous princess with an excessively innocent mind. I obsess over the male lead, pick fights, and eventually die in a demon attack, thus plunging the reputation of the knight order the male lead belongs to into ruin... 

'Oh, this isn't a knight order, it's a rabble!' I looked around at the disheveled knights with a dumbfounded expression. 

"Sir, Are you properly contracted? What about overtime pay? Is there any compensation in case of accidents? How about medical support for mental stress and physical injuries?"  
"Why are you suddenly asking this, Your Highness?" The male lead asked me suspiciously. Well, I once obsessively pursued him, so I understand his wariness.   
"You should call me 'Administrator' instead of 'Your Highness'."   
"No, that's..."   
"Kashia Astrid, as of today, you've been assigned as the administrative supply officer for the Azure Radiance Knights." I smiled sweetly at the bewildered male lead.   
"Also, please rest assured, I'll no longer obsess over you anymore." His looks? Obsession? Sweet and bitter romance? What use are those when the world is on the brink of destruction!   
"If you keep this up, I might accidentally send a letter of complaint to the Emperor about this matter." Playing the villainess, I even slapped him in the commander's office.   
"Hey, do you want us to wash your socks too? Do you lose your hands? Huh?" I even confronted the absurd military culture.   
"Don't be discouraged, it's not your fault." I comforted the mentally shattered future saviors. 

"Hurrah for the Administrative Supply Officer!"   
"You're our savior!"   
"Hail, Kashia!"   
...Why did our knights turn into my fan club? And on top of that...   
"The Administrator will never leave us. Do you understand?" Why did even the stoic male lead lose his composure?!

[Promotional Novel/Webtoon](https://page.kakao.com/content/64007540/viewer/64038114)

She claims to have returned from a distant future where an evil organization conquered the world, making it a dreadful place to live. She says the Mu-Jin she saw before dying crushed enemies with overwhelming power. Therefore, “You... become my comrade!” Though this absurd confession makes Mu-Jin slightly concerned about Ji-Su's mental state, his arrogant conceit, thinking a hunter's life might be fun, leads him to enroll in the Hunter Academy. One day, a demon and his contractor visit the garden. Noticing Adam’s loneliness, they cut off one of his fingers, shaping it into a new living being before leaving again.

Alone together in the garden, Adam raises this new life and passes down his knowledge. Yet even as he feels comfort in its presence, he cannot ignore the strange aversion he feels toward a being born from his own flesh.

As the new life grows increasingly obsessed with him, Adam tries to keep his distance. At last, their tension reaches a breaking point.

The person who used to leave the master bedroom without a second thought after work now wanted to sleep in the same bed and brought me tickets to a concert by my favorite pianist.

Why was he suddenly acting like this?
My heart, which I'd thought dry, began to beat with renewed vigor.

Maybe, just maybe, I could live happily with him... I harbored such a foolish hope.

“Would you like to use me tonight?” Cha Mona had everything. Beauty, talent, background. Everything except one thing: luck with men. “Why does every guy I date end up like this?” It was the day she broke up with her boyfriend. The same boyfriend she found rolling around in her bed with another woman. “I’m turning thirty next year, and every single relationship I’ve had has been a failure. Is there really not a single decent guy out there?” “Director, do you really need to date?” Kang Doha wasn’t just Mona’s secretary. He was someone she had known for over ten years, like a younger brother. Or so she thought. Until he said something no one could have expected. “Would you like to use me tonight?” In the noisy restaurant, his low voice was the only thing that rang clear in her ears. Why was her heart racing like this? Just like it did that day, eight years ago, when they saw each other again for the first time.

Han Sun-yul has long been scarred by a scandal involving her college sweetheart, Yoo Shin.
After eight years, he reappeared in front of her, leaving nothing but shameful rumors and resentment for Yoo Shin, who evaporated in an instant.
“Did you miss me?”
“What?”
“You had that look on your face.”
As if that weren't bad enough, he brazenly reappeared as if nothing had happened,
“Don't marry Kim Ki-chul.”
“He's worse than you can imagine. He'll only hurt you.”
Sun-yeon can't understand why he's so intent on her boyfriend, Ki-chul.
But she soon realizes that there's something between Yoo Shin and Ki-chul that she doesn't understand...

description:
U-Rim’s whole world used to revolve around the popular idol Ga-Ron. But after meeting Ju-Yeol in college, he fell head over heels for him so much so that he was on the verge of dropping out of school. With his good looks, sharp mind, and talent for playing in a band, Ju-Yeol is simply perfect! U-Rim, thrilled to accept his invitation to a band practice, encounters a suspicious figure loitering outside the door. But this suspicious stranger was actually my favorite idol, Ga-Ron?! Just as he found himself with Ga-Ron, U-Rim noticed an alert for Ga-Ron’s live stream. He was puzzled by the stark contrast between his dazzling appearance on the live feed and the shabby-looking Ga-Ron standing right in front of him. Ga-Ron manages to escape the crisis with a flustered excuse, but, fearing that U-Rim might expose his secret, he stubbornly insists on staying at U-Rim’s house. U-Rim grows even more suspicious of Ga-Ron’s behavior… Ga-Ron’s true identity is slowly revealed! What secret does my favorite idol on the other side of the screen have…?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

In the early 2000s, 'Taehee,' a cheerful and confident girl popular among her peers, takes pity on 'Guwon,' a loner who transfers to her school, and becomes her closest friend.

A story about the turbulent adolescence of young girls navigating friendships and emotions.

Medusa, a monster known for her grotesque appearance but who in truth loves children, comes across a child destined to kill her inside a chest that has washed ashore. Determined to avoid her fate of death, she resolves not to kill the child but to raise him instead. She gives him a name and lovingly brings him up. Carefully dodging the potentially fatal crises caused by the child’s every little action, Medusa does her best at childcare. However, a group of humans searching for the child eventually appears before her. Medusa soon realises that they have come to kill him… 

Will Medusa be able to escape her destined death and live happily with the child? 

A reinterpretation of Medusa—the widely known monster of myth—as a warm, heroic protagonist, along with a newly imagined relationship with her nemesis Perseus. A work intended to be easy to read even for those unfamiliar with the original myth.

yet Yeon Dahae turned my life upside down.

“Yeon Dahae, manager of the upcoming ‘Only You: Coffee & Flower,’ opening next week.”

I couldn’t let this slip by.

“I’m not after money—I’d rather settle it differently. What do you say?”

I had to figure out why that morning, when she left without a word, I felt so hollow and restless.

“How about this: we meet whenever we want, without strings or complications?”

All I needed to do was enjoy it—nothing more.

description:
At first there was “Lake,” and then there was “Island.” Or was it the other way around? A story told in two parts, it is up to the reader to determine where they’d like to begin this eerie journey. Based on a true story that Yeong-shin Ma felt compelled to help share, together these two parts are Hodo—the story of a painter, whose hard and dark past is brought to life with sensitivity and authenticity. Lake— Hodo is haunted—by her mother and step-mother, her classmates, a neighbor, and yes, literal ghosts. She is also five years old. Through masterful cartooning, we see a child’s despair in the face of pervasive violence, and her confusion as to why bad things keep happening to her. We see the edges of her depression begin to appear. Island— Hodo is haunted—by her past, a friend’s suicide, her sister’s heartbreaking yet unsurprising betrayal, and yes, literal ghosts, still. Through masterful cartooning, we see a woman reckoning with her past and the shadow it has cast on her adulthood. But we also see her develop her artistic practice and witness her determination to find herself through her paintbrush. Because despite the incredible pain, Hodo is a story of light in the dark—a story of hope.
Source: Drawn & Quarterly
