titles.title: Raising Hell: A Demon's Guide to Parenting

description:
What happens when a demon is out-deviled by a child? It doesn't take long for the former "Demon King" of Hell to be domesticated by a pint-sized human he attempts to raise.

Source: Webtoon

Adam, a half-vampire living with his father in the city, eagerly anticipates gaining full vampire powers at a certain age. However, upon turning 17, he grapples with the challenges of controlling his abilities and navigating complex emotions, such as love…
Source: Webtoon

Monsters live among us. A mysterious creature called the "GENDERUWO" was just a local myth - no one paid attention, no one cared - until the day of the breakout. A defense force was formed to protect the people from monster attacks, and among them was Venix - a young soldier discredited by the rest but desperate to prove himself. Little do they know there is more about this kid than they first believed. A Monster lives among them.

Source: Webtoon

Since she ran away from the capital, Siomara has played it safe. Mainly she tries to ignore the Darkness that inhabits this world, which she is now capable of seeing, but more importantly, she makes sure that the Darkness ignores her as well. But when a mysterious neighbor moves in that could also be like her, Siomara must decide if she’ll risk getting closer to him, despite all the warnings of the danger that he comes with.

(Source: Webtoon)

We are having a baby! From pregnancy to baby crawling, every day is filled with cuteness and no sleep.
Source: Webtoon

When Azriel — the fearsome and unfeeling Angel of Death — allows a human soul to slip through his fingers, God casts him down to Earth to find it. Azriel plans to use Jo LeCourt, the sister of the woman whose soul he failed to reap, to guide him. But he’s not counting on the sharp-witted and relentless Jo, who knows why he's there and will stop at nothing to stop him. As the two circle each other, Azriel discovers, for the first time in eternity, someone who really challenges and interests him. And Jo discovers, for the first time in her life, someone as reliable and exacting as she is. Neither of them are expecting to find a love that will change them forever.

(Source: Webtoon)

Juniper was always the Dungeon Master, never the player. He was always a creator of worlds rather than the one who walked within them…until now. Somehow, the tables have turned in the most dramatic way possible. Juniper finds himself in a world filled with the wildest fantasies a mind could come up with, and his fingerprints are all over it. Throughout this world, echoes of his own ideas and plots leave him feeling like he’s always one step behind. He finds bits and pieces of ancient influence strewn about every town he goes through. One thing is clear, though: Juniper walks this magical new world in someone else’s shadow. It might all add up to something vital...if only he can survive long enough to figure it out.
Source: Webtoon

What happens when two yandere stalkers fall in love with each other?

(Source: Webtoons)

Shaye has always had a very noble dream: to date an extremely hot girl. However, after she meets her dream girl, the cute tomboy Charlie, it proves to be more difficult than expected... Join Shaye and Charlie on their cute, goofy, awkward, and (hopefully?) sexy attempt at dating.

(Source: Webtoon)
Having a cat is a huge responsibility, especially if that cat is Mochi! Mochi is chaotic, unpredictable, and hard to control--but at the end of the day, Mono wouldn't trade him for the world.

Hana has recently just fallen in love with her best friend, who just happens to be a girl. After a confrontation with her best friend, Hana accidentally blurts out and confesses her true feelings. Fearing that she would be rejected, her friend accepts her feelings graciously and they start dating. Is this a dream? Hana, overwhelmed with happiness as her wish came true- is suddenly struck down, her world crashing down as she finds out the nasty truth about her best friend.

The Empire stands triumphant. For twenty years the Dread Empress has ruled over the lands that were once the Kingdom of Callow, but behind the scenes of this dawning golden age threats to the crown are rising. The nobles of the Wasteland weave their plots behind pleasant smiles while rebellion stirs beyond Peren Woods, for dreams of crowns were buried in shallow graves. The greatest danger of all lies to the west, where the First Prince of Procer restored order at last: her people sundered, she ponders if a crusade might not be the way to secure her reign. Yet none of this matters, for in the heart of the conquered lands the most dangerous man alive sat across an orphan girl and offered her a knife. Her name is Catherine Foundling, and she has a plan.

Source: Webtoon

When Manny enters the Rodríguez family's life, his charming facade masks a dark nature that threatens to tear their household apart. As tensions rise and secrets are exposed, the family must confront the true identity and sinister motives of their supposed caregiver. 

(Source: Webtoon)

The top student is a fake!? Alejandro Mamani has the best grades in school but it’s all thanks to his perfect cheating skills. His whole charade falls apart on the day of the university selection exams, where he answers blank. Unexpectedly, on the day of the results, he wakes up with the surprise of a perfect score that hasn’t been seen for more than 10 years, awarding him the title of the “Triple Ace.” However, there is a professor’s assistant who knows his secret and won’t let him get away with his lie.
Source: Webtoon

Giselle should support the royal engagement - she's the princess's best friend, after all! But it's hard to watch your love get married to someone else. What's a girl to do? Team up with the one other person in the kingdom not celebrating the marriage: a handsome rogue who wants the princess' fiance dead. When Giselle learns the engagement is not what it seems, she's willing to get her hands dirty. Can a noble lady and a street rat stop this courtship from sailing?
Source: Webtoon

"Never sail into the sea when your heart bears the weight of sorrow," Jaena, burdened by the pain of a recent breakup, stumbles upon a mystical encounter that changes her life forever. As the deep sea threatens to swallow her whole, an alluring beauty emerges from the depths, followed by a kiss that ignites a bond between two worlds — that of a human and an annoying, flirtatious siren.

display_title: My Best Friend is an Eldritch Horror
mangabaka_title: My Best Friend is an Eldritch Horror

titles.title: My Best Friend is an Eldritch Horror

description:
Good things come to those who wait. Damien Vale didn't, and now he's bound to an Eldritch creature from beyond the farthest reaches of the universe. It's unfathomable, utterly evil, and likes to be called Henry. To Damien, none of that mattered. He was going to learn magic, and he'd be damned if he let something as small as this set him back.

(Source: Webtoon)

Ten year old Ruby Ledger has been missing for over 6 months. Her family thinks they've finally found her... The truth? Well, I won't tell if you don't.

Source: Webtoon

Park Chanmi vividly remembers her past life, where she harbored deep feelings for the beautiful Hanbyeol, whose life tragically ended too soon. In her present life, Chanmi is startled to discover that her lost love has returned as a university professor yet does not recall their past life. Fearing history may repeat itself, Chanmi is determined to protect the sole person she cherishes the most.

(Source: Webtoon)

After a reckless electrical fire burns their dorm room to a crisp, college girls Bonnie and Aline find themselves homeless the day before their semester starts! With nothing but the clothes on their back, the mysterious rich-girl Kitty Kandikova offers them an deal they can't refuse: free rent, all amenities paid, and essentially a life of luxury. The catch: they must completely give up their social lives to become her fake best friends, and potential bridesmaids?!

(Source: Webtoon)

Many years after the "Hollows", super humans with unique abilities, appeared on Earth, Elliot discovers that he has the strange ability to imitate the "singularities of other Hollows. He is quickly recruited by EMBER, a government organization dedicated to the care and elimination of wild hollows. With his unorthodox crew, he seeks to find the reason other Hollows across the country are transforming into monsters!
Source: Webtoon

Hidden between one day and the next is a mysterious phenomenon called the Dark Hour: a time period where otherworldly creatures prey on human psyches, leaving behind victims with the debilitating Apathy Syndrome. In the midst of this darkness, the unknowing second-year transfer student Makoto Yuki arrives at Gekkoukan High School – and through a chance encounter, or perhaps fate itself, awakens a new power within…

(Source: Webtoon)

Hell bent on avenging those he’s lost, Valerian vows to hunt down the Scarlet Telkemist, leader of illicit blood-magic users called vourdaks. But when Alesya, a dead girl from his past, turns up alive and amnesiac, he realizes the vourdaks’ secrets run deeper than he'd imagined. Can Alesya be the key to helping Valerian capture the Scarlet Telkemist once and for all, or will she bring his undoing?
Source: Webtoon

Erika is the city's strongest Magical Girl and leader of the dazzling Star Chroma group! But when she sacrifices herself to defeat the terrifying Spore Queen Miasma, it's up to her best friend Winnie to pick up the pieces. Or in this case, fall to pieces. 8 years later and Star Chroma is no more and Winnie is stuck in a dead end office job. But when the Spore Queen unexpectedly returns, Winnie will have to find a way to manage on her own. At least until an old friend reappears as well...
Source: Webtoon

A progression fantasy epic set in a time-loop where planning and cleverness are as vital as swordplay, about a spoiled prince who discovers what it means to rule. Watch as he gains power, learns magic, forges alliances, and delves deeper into the mystery of the loop itself and the nature of his relationship with the ruthless antagonist.
Source: Webtoon

When a failed scientist falls in love with the zombie he's studying for a cure.
Source: Webtoon

A girl gets roped into helping an overly-dramatic otaku she meets in detention confess his love to the school jock he has a crush on.
Includes 4 epilogue chapters.

Zak, the greatest assassin to ever live, gets betrayed and killed, only to wake up two centuries later in a bioengineered body. Having been unable to save his wife and keep his promise to her, Zak uses his new body, and the Nano-technology hidden within, to navigate through a new futuristic age of assassins and seek out the ones responsible for his tragedy.
Source: Webtoon
Includes 1 epilogue chapter.

Strange bunny girls have been appearing all over the city, attempting to recruit people into a mysterious cult known as "The Warren Divine".
Source: Webtoon

A salaryman summons Astaroth, a Prince of Hell, to help him stop getting bullied at work.
Source: Webtoon

In a world torn between the Sky and the Lands, siblings Mia and Sera embark on a quest to reunite with the only family they have ever known—Mother Theresa. Separated by fate, their journey is filled with surprises, wonder, and sorrow. As they traverse breathtaking landscapes and encounter both friends and foes, they must confront their deepest fears, discover the power of love and hope, and learn to believe in themselves. Yet hidden within Mia lies a secret that could change their fate—and the fate of the entire world.

*Source: NamiComi*

Being an adventurer used to be the most dangerous profession in Geovora, but that changed with a revolutionary invention–battle dolls. Kuhl spends most of his time fixing these dolls, but he’s never had the coin to pull for one himself. He’s too busy saving to help his sick sister. However, when he stumbles upon Anika, an unregistered battle doll with no memory, the two may be able to help each other. Together, they set off on a quest to cure Kuhl’s sister and unlock the secrets of Anika’s past!
Source: Tapas

The story follows a teenage loan shark, Castiel, who is murdered and then resurrected and must now follow the orders of the shadowy group who brought him back. Tasked with slaying the devil himself, Castiel must dodge numerous perils in a world where some beings can create real-life horrors just by speaking about them.
Source: Dark Horse

In a country where cricket is like a religion and people have strong feelings about it, Ishaan has lost that connection after a heartbreaking event. Now, with the Cricket World Cup happening in India, everyone is excited as India plays in the semi-finals, hoping to reach the finals. What's next for them and Ishaan?

Retail:  
Official English

Official Hindi

Adventuring isn’t as easy as it looks. This band of misfits are in way over their heads.
Source: Webtoon

Omari’s dream was always to become a professional basketball player. But that dream was quickly crushed by reality. There’s school, money, his strict aunt, and the future, of which he wasn’t sure of until a mysterious scout discovers his talent with a ball and offers him a ticket to Overtime Elite Academy, a high-tech program designed to craft the world's greatest basketball player. Does Omari have what it takes to survive against the most competitive basketball talent? Or will his dream slip away again?
Source: Webtoon

Venus is one of the most feared, hated and misunderstood creatures in the land: a Kelpie. After Nero, the water god who created the Kelpies gets imprisoned, Venus hides on an island with her son. One day, her son dies in a tragic accident, and Venus suddenly finds herself on a journey to bring him back. Along the way, she'll have to face dangers, enemies, and make new friends.
Source: Webtoon

When an accident kills over forty people in a small mining town, two high school students venture into an underworld filled with innumerable wonders in order to expose a deep conspiracy at the heart of a creeping corruption; an exploration on living with grief, hand-in-hand with death.
Source: Webtoon

It's the Killer's job to trick his targets into falling in love with him, which hasn't been an issue in the past. That is until he ends up falling in love with his next target, who just so happens to be an infamous celebrity and someone from his past. Can a serial killer date his celebrity target? Or is that too taboo?
Source: Webtoon

display_title: Captain Laserhawk: A Blood Dragon Remix
mangabaka_title: Captain Laserhawk: A Blood Dragon Remix

titles.title: Captain Laserhawk: A Blood Dragon Remix

description:
Dolph Laserhawk, the once-powerful and illustrious super-soldier stationed under the oppressive Eden mega-corporation, stands at a crossroads between staying a mindless killing machine under Eden’s control and joining a band of rebel outcasts on a risky undercover mission. Before he can finally be free of the manipulative forces surrounding him, he must relive the best and worst moments of his life. Using Holloway’s VR technology, he walks through his memories of living as a penniless deserter, meeting and abandoning the love of his life, and coming to terms with the truth behind his passionate and tumultuous love affair with Alex Taylor — the ruggedly handsome criminal mastermind who once saved his life.
Source: Tokyopop

Polaris is king of the stars; with his celestial paint brush he breathes life into constellations, which protect his kingdom. Yildun is his loyal knight, ever at his side, but always in shadow as his station dictates him to remain unseen. Together, they will face a battle for the throne from Polaris' brother — as well as their own conflicting feelings. A love story written in the stars!
Source: Tokyopop

Ever since Belle’s fateful meeting with a dying enchantress, life in her quiet village hasn’t been the same—the villagers never seem to rest, shadows lurk behind the newly erected walls, and there are whispers that deep in the woods, people are turning into monsters… Only Belle, gifted with the last of the enchantress’s magic, has the power to protect her father and her village from the strange, twisted influence of the woods. But as the paranoid villagers turn on one another and a mysterious call for help appears just outside the walls, Belle must journey to the source of the cursed magic—and find those who are seeking to use it for themselves—before her world is overrun with horrors and the true beast of the woods is revealed.
Source: VIZ

Teiko’s fearless motivation for cold hard cash leads him to a brush with death, awakening powerful Morale within him. This supernatural Morale makes him a recruit for the Anti-Depressers, an organization fighting monstrous Killjoys born from negative human emotions. When a mysterious group starts turning people in Killjoys, Teiko and his unorthodox team must battle to protect the innocent and uncover a conspiracy that runs deep. But Teiko’s fate is a little different: his strength may be more Killjoy than human!

An anomaly once believed to be the key to understanding the secrets of the universe has instead become the catalyst for a conflict with the creatures known as the Strata. It’s a conflict that threatens all existence. Piloting a towering Bio-Mechanical Symbiote known as an Intrepid, Fiora arrives on the front lines of the war against the Strata. Hoping to turn the tide and extinguish this seemingly unstoppable blight on humanity, Fiora soon learns that a war is being waged within her as well.
Sourcea: Tokyopop

display_title: My Super Eldritch High School Melee Festival
mangabaka_title: My Super Eldritch High School Melee Festival

titles.title: My Super Eldritch High School Melee Festival

description:
In just a few days, the Eldritch Meleé Festival at Cambia High School will begin. Fighters of the Four Houses will test their skill in the martial and metaphysical arts. Leyla and her BFF Tama want to spend the day like normal school girls for a change, but Leyla finds two suspicious love letters in her locker...
Source: Webtoon

When executioner and champion of the people, Master Yu, goes missing, Ari, San, and Reaper set out to find him, each for different reasons. San, the dokebi and Master Yu's biggest fanboy, looks to him for guidance. Ari, a mysterious child that can't speak, seeks revenge. And Reaper is on a mission to collect the Master's soul before it expires and they all face greater consequences.
Source: Webtoon

display_title: Taejin: Legend of the Yang Metal
mangabaka_title: Taejin: Legend of the Yang Metal
romanized_title: Taejin: Legend of the Yang Metal

titles.title: Taejin: Legend of the Yang Metal

description:
Rebellious teenager Taejin Choi pawns a mysterious family heirloom talisman, setting off a chain of events that awaken latent Yang Metal powers and lead him to fulfill his cosmic destiny, to work with a group of Bazi users and use their powers to protect Philadelphia from evil.
Source: Webtoon

In her forever-festering pit of a hometown, all that the 22-year old exterminator Katlaya wants is a monster-free future... with a hot wife! On this one night, Katlaya will fight through everything that gets in the way of her ideal future-- be it corrupting monster, corrupt officials, or even the town's cult god, Amihan.
Source: Webtoon

A kindhearted super human has always dreamt of becoming a superhero, but when her family becomes desperate for money, she takes a high paying job as a henchman for a notorious supervillain.
Source: Webtoon

Ben Crews has been kicked around by life one too many times. So when his grandmother offers him a place at her fancy estate, Heart Acres, he jumps on the opportunity to live a life of luxury. Imagine his surprise when he finds out the estate is crumbling, and he's been hired to fix it! And the twists don't stop coming when he finds out he has some unexpected hot and haunted roommates who seem a little too excited to have a cute guy around...
Source: Webtoon

All inhabitants of the Land of the Sun develop the power to shapeshift by the age of five—all except one. Still waiting for his powers even as a teenager, Copper spends every day searching for ways to awaken his abilities. But when his search leaves him stuck in a foreign, snow-covered land, he'll come to find that the world, and his destiny, are much bigger than he could have ever imagined.
Source: Webtoon

On a continent where specters and magic are but legends, Miranda, a medium with the ability to communicate with spirits, and Victor, a foreign exorcist with a mysterious past, embark on an odyssey through South America to La Gran Argentina. Bound together by their talents, they seek personal goals that only together they can accomplish. However, unaware that they are being haunted by Victor's past, their journey becomes a race against time. And what began as a simple alliance turns into something much deeper.
Source: Webtoon

Felix meant to buy a video game but ended up simulating a universe. A story about learning to love, the meaning of life, and the value of existence.

(Source: Webtoon)

Amakusa Rin, fearsome daughter of the Blue Dragon faction leader, and Horii Shinsuke, soft-spoken fighter of the Shirai faction, find themselves in a strange situation. To consolidate power between their factions they have to… get married?! With Rin hell-bent on avenging her mother’s death and Shin determined to marry only for love, their union is doomed from the start. After negotiating an engagement period, Rin and Shin must find a way to annul their marriage without instigating all out war between their factions. Can they succeed before their wedding night… or before they catch feelings?
Source: Webtoon

Silas Reinheart awakens to the afterlife and faces the consequences of his dying words. He had cursed the gods and blamed them for the horror that had struck his village.
And now, Silas finds himself in hell, doomed to rot for an eternity. But when the devil himself offers Silas a deal, his fate is altered. 
"Return to the Earth and collect their souls... or perish in my kingdom, forever."
Join Silas on his adventure of becoming the strongest devil. Witness the tale of his revenge and the journey of his redemption!

After a bad first year at university, Michael returns to school after a taking a year off to manage his mental health. His life has mostly returned to normal but he still has a feeling of uncertainty. Afraid of getting hurt, he keeps everyone at a distance until the "ice queen" catches his attention. Through his attempt to pursue her, he realizes in order to melt her heart, he has to open up his. Slowly, the distance between them begins to close..

(Source: Webtoon)

Sophia is a stunning, cunning, cold-hearted Succubus who goes through men like a bad habit. She runs the streets, striking fear into the hearts of the toughest mobsters and blood sucking creatures of the night. She's an unstoppable force, but Sophia has a problem…she’s fallen in love! And what will she do if the only way to survive is to feed on her beloved? If she’s not careful, this little thing called “Love” will be the death of her!
Source: Webtoon

In a world overrun by vampyres, one city stands strong as a bastion of hope. Led by two strong Commanders and reliable Captains, the city manages to hold off the vampyric hordes. Lumir, son of the two Commanders, is the hope of the city and guarantees the safety of the generation for decades to come, but a brutal tragedy approaches as an unknown force sets its eyes on the city.
Source: Webtoon

In a distant empire, the young Emperor is consumed by his duties, yet the people whisper that he’s overdue for marriage. When Tran, a spirited working-class woman, unexpectedly saves the Emperor—disguised and in danger—their unlikely friendship ignites into a daring romance. As they face formidable enemies determined to thwart the Emperor’s reign, together they craft a legacy that redefines the future of the empire.
Source: Webtoon

Angels ferry the good souls to Heaven. Devils ferry the bad souls to Hell. That is how the afterlife is written. Evangeline was born a Devil, but has always dreamed of becoming an Angel and helping souls live a beautiful afterlife. When she encounters Tatrasiel, an Angel curious of Hell, she proposes the impossible: switching lives to see how the other lives! But they'll soon discover Heaven and Hell isn't quite what either of them expected!
Source: Webtoon

In a world of people gifted with supernatural abilities, a boy with a power deemed ‘marginal’ by society navigates life surrounded by his marginally extraordinary peers.
Source: Webtoon
The daily life of villainous and feared Lord Anathema and his daughter, Desdemona, as they temporarily reside in the realm of Earth.

After the mysterious murder of his parents, Yoichi Sakagami struggled to live a normal life taking care of his young siblings. The only way he survived was by exploiting a mysterious ability he had to regenerate his organs. But when shadowy forces come after him, he'll find that there's more to his ability than he thought. Will he be able to control it to get his revenge and protect those he cares about? Or will the power he has control him instead?

(Source: Webtoon)

Forced to take over his family’s technology company, struggling college student Kaito agrees to the terms of a seemingly harmless video game meant to be an online tutorial for IT, only to realize too late that he’s become a contestant in a battle royale where he’ll fight to win a passing grade…or die trying.
Source: Webtoon

How hard is it to kill a princess? Rafael, a cocky assassin, takes on a job to kill Sazet, the princess of the empire, but soon finds that she is not the easy target he thought. When they are forced to team up, Rafael must decide if he will bury his dagger in her heart…. Or if his will be captured first.

(Source: Webtoon)

Yohan Silang is on a mission of revenge to destroy the demon lords who massacred his village. In order to achieve his goals, he must rise through the ranks to become the most powerful Seeker in the land. The only thing that can stop him is death. Or can it? When dying is just another opportunity to grow stronger, Yohan will do whatever it takes to have his revenge.
Source: Webtoon

Obi is just an average high schooler who needs money for a date with the girl he likes. But when he signs a contract for a part-time job with a shady boss, he isn't prepared for the fine print… bringing the souls of the damned under heel! With new powers and more to his past than he realizes, he will have to become stronger in order to save the girl… and the world!
Source: Webtoon

When Cyan dies in a tragic accident, a devil appears with a tempting offer—a second chance at life in exchange for his soul. But things take an unexpected twist when the devil accidentally hands over a romantic contract instead. As they fumble to undo the mistake, a shocking secret comes to light, binding them in ways they never imagined...

(Source: Webtoon)
If you can control the will of what the gods want, how far will you go? Join the journey of Suki to unravel the mystery of life in a mind bending shonen manga series.

display_title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles x Naruto
mangabaka_title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles x Naruto

titles.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles x Naruto

description:
When teenage reporter April O’Neil has a clandestine meeting with Tsunade, the leader of the Hidden Leaf Village, it garners the attention of Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura, and Kakashi. They aren’t the only ones who are wondering what the two women were discussing, though. The sinister Foot Clan have their own interest in April’s visit, as they think she might hold the valuable information on mutation research being conducted by the scientist Baxter Stockman. With April caught between the forces of the Hidden Leaf Village and the Foot Clan, it can’t be long before the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles show up to lend her a hand!

(Source: IDW)

In a universe where Earth is nothing but a distant memory, humanity's last refuge is space stations threatened by ruthless black-eyed creatures called Onyxes. After a brutal encounter with one of them, young orphan Kazuo vows to turn his fear into strength. Determined to become Hunter, an elite warrior from Adamas Academy, Kazuo embarks on a dangerous journey to protect humanity and prove that he's not just a survivor - he's a hero in the making.

(Source: Webtoon)

In a world filled with zombies, a bounty hunter and a woman with mysterious powers team up in a battle for survival.

(Source: Viz)
When God disappears, six young people are drawn into a battle to recover Akasha.

Our story begins with young Théna, apprentice swordsman and resident of Little Island, an island far too small for her audacity and thirst to discover the world. An irresistible desire to go to the continent does not leave her, and a mysterious wandering boy whom she saves in extremis from danger could well be her first adventure companion! But they will have to be wary of the cruel King Mimas, a real threat to any hope of freedom...

Lumi has always dismissed the strange "ghosts" she sees until her best friend Rachel disappears, only to return as a ghost. Now Lumi must face the world she never believed in and solve the mystery of Rachel's disappearance. Diving deeper into the darkness, Lumi discovers that some truths are more terrifying and painful than any ghost.

(Source: Webtoons)

Allan Rose, an orphan awakener with the potential to be one of the strongest S-rankers has been stuck at level one for eight years. He often dreams of reaching his full potential but is always awakened to the cruel reality of being a poor F-ranker who must steal to put food on the table. One day his best friend convinces him to go on an illegal expedition so that he can finally see what it's like to be a true awakener. Unfortunately, things go south, and Allan finds himself standing at death's door. Against all odds he survives, and finds out that whatever was keeping him from leveling up has disappeared. Now, with the ability to level up, he is doing whatever he can to gain strength so that can he bring happiness and luxury to his orphanage family.

(Source: Webtoons)

After battling with numerous hardships and an unsuccessful attempt at his own life, Lucas transformed from a true ray of sunshine to a meek and depressed young adult. He shuts out those around him to focus on his studies at the world-renowned Star Valley University in the hopes of making a positive impact in the world one day. Never would he imagine that a by-chance run in with a stranger would result in him learning to forgive and love himself, and find the passion to live life for himself again.

(Source: Webtoon)

What happens when two yandere stalkers fall in love with each other?

(Source: Webtoons)

The story revolves around the employee Hayato, who works in a company that manufactures games, and his strict and serious manager.

(Source: Webtoon)

display_title: Avatar: The Last Airbender - The Bounty Hunter and the Tea Brewer
mangabaka_title: Avatar: The Last Airbender - The Bounty Hunter and the Tea Brewer

titles.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender - The Bounty Hunter and the Tea Brewer

description:
Deliveries to Uncle Iroh's tea house, the Jasmine Dragon, have dried up! Further complicating Iroh's life, a familiar face – the bounty hunter June – has captured him in hopes of a payday large enough to set her and Nyla up for life. Who hired June, and what do they want with the former Dragon of the West? In an epic trek across the Earth Kingdom, Iroh must confront a part of his past while June considers her future, but however things go...someone's got to free the tea!

(Source: Fan Wiki)

Navi realizes he's a male lead in a 19+ reverse harem novel, but the other male leads are chasing him instead of the female lead! Desperate for peace, he turns to a mysterious guild master for help. Can he escape this chaotic romance?

(Source: Tapas)
